title: Selected candidate qualification facts; values require linked raw evidence

paired_gain_lcb.description: Direction-normalized paired ratio lower bound MINUS ONE, using the more conservative of bootstrap and t-interval (tools.metrics.paired_summary.ci95_low). ratio 1.04 -> gain fraction 0.04, not 1.04.

paired_n.description: Number of aligned ABBA pairs behind paired_gain_lcb for the primary bucket; gate requires >= 8 (docs/02 §3).

aa_noise_abs.description: max |ratio-1| observed in the baseline-vs-baseline (A/A) run of the same harness and bucket; gate requires <= 0.03.

task_wall_ratio.description: Candidate wall time / baseline wall time

capacity.description: Verified input+output+template tokens; protected value is 200192 (docs/02 §3), not the production 262144.
